theorems.name: Submission.rsod_c1ab_clm_lusin_closed
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), Measurable F → ∀ S : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet S → volume S ≠ ∞ → ∀ δ : ℝ≥0∞, δ ≠ 0 → ∃ C : Set (Rn n), C ⊆ S ∧ IsClosed C ∧ volume (S \ C) < δ ∧ ContinuousOn F C
